rule: Resolve config YAML directories in unit tests via `from maxtext.utils.globals import MAXTEXT_CONFIGS_DIR` (`Path(MAXTEXT_CONFIGS_DIR) / 'models'`) rather than `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[N] / 'src' / 'maxtext' / 'configs'`, which breaks when CI executes tests against an installed wheel.

PR `cpu-unit` runners omit `torch`; never import `torch` at module top level, call `pytest.importorskip('torch')` at module scope, or decorate an entire `TestCase` class with `@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_TORCH)` when the class also contains pure-JAX tests—apply `@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_TORCH)` at the method level only on tests that call `torch`.

In `nnx_decoders.py` and `scan_layers=True` block wrappers, honor `config.remat_policy == 'none'` by skipping block-level `jax.checkpoint` / `nnx.remat` wrapping so `remat_policy='none'` disables rematerialization consistently across both scanned and unscanned layer execution.

Annotate grouped depthwise `conv1d` kernel weights (for example linear-attention `conv1d.kernel`) on the `tensor` logical axis whenever activations are sharded along `tensor`; unannotated grouped `conv1d` weights produce identical forward outputs at `TP>1` while XLA's backward weight-gradient `all-reduce` scales gradients by a factor of `TP`.

Whenever `train_step`, `loss_fn`, or `eval_step` in `train.py` reads a new `config.<attr>`, add that field to the `_Cfg` dataclass in `tests/unit/train_nnx_test.py` and gate new graph behavior behind an opt-in `false` default in `base.yml` so `tests/integration/hlo_diff_test.py` reference HLO dumps remain unchanged.

Pass `git -c safe.directory=*` whenever invoking `git` subprocesses inside tests, developer scripts, or CI workflows so containerized runners whose container UID differs from the bind-mounted workspace owner do not fail with exit code 128 (`detected dubious ownership`).

For capacity-bounded collectives and sharded lookups (`all_to_all`, ragged dispatch, `ragged_buffer_factor`, `moe_dropless_buffer_factor`, per-shard `cap`), verify skewed hot-shard routing (`count > cap` on a single shard) alongside uniform splits, and never silently zero dropped rows on an exact lookup.

Wrap any `os.environ` mutation in unit tests inside `unittest.mock.patch.dict(os.environ, ...)` (and restore any `jax.config.update` in `addCleanup`/`tearDown`) so mutated flags cannot leak into subsequent tests running in the same `pytest-split` worker.

Do not treat a red `Track Test Performance / Track Test Duration` check run on a pull request as a blocking regression by itself; it compares against a rolling single-sample `gh-pages` baseline without `--warn-only` and is intentionally excluded from `All Required Tests Passed` and `auto_label_pr.yml`.

Do not flag positive `isinstance(x, jax.core.Tracer)` dispatch guards that inspect `x.aval.memory_space` or select `jax.device_put` placement in host-offload helpers; only negated `not isinstance(x, Tracer)` guards that bypass validation under `jax.jit` or materialize tracers on the host are defects.
